root.name: Ruy Lopez: Halloween Attack
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Nf6 4. Nxe5

overview: White sacrifices the knight with 4.Nxe5 Nxe5 5.d4, hoping to regain material and gain a strong centre with tempo on the black pieces. Black can keep the piece with 5...Ng6 or ...Nxe4 and has the better game with correct play. It is a rare surprise on the Berlin move order.

white_ideas.idea: Regain material with d4 and e5
Use the central pawn mass and development

black_ideas.idea: Keep the extra piece and return it cleanly

character.notes: The name suggests the Halloween Gambit idea on the Berlin move order.

gambit.notes: White offers a knight for a pawn and Black can keep it by retreating.

character.reason: A piece sacrifice leads to wild play.

level.reason: A dubious line is never Beginner.

plans.reason: White seeks tempo and a pawn centre.
